title: Viva Insights: Agent 365 Dashboard adds reporting for third-party platform agents
notes: claim 88: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap dates, dashboard prerequisites, access paths and PowerShell controls are supported. It correctly distinguishes the planned expansion from existing dashboard and registry capabilities; the statement that most employees do not use the dashboard is not documented and should be removed.

claims.claim: The printed Microsoft 365 admin center path reaches Agent Dashboard policy creation.
claims.quote: Go to the Settings tab and select Microsoft Viva, then Viva Insights. On this page, go to the Set up and management tab. ... Under Access Management, select Turn Advanced Insights on or off. ... On the Feature access management page, select Agent Dashboard and Add policy.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy with VivaInsights, AgentDashboard, IsFeatureEnabled false and Everyone creates a tenant-wide dashboard-disable policy.
claims.quote: Example: Turn off the Agent Dashboard for all users in your tenant ... ModuleId : VivaInsights ... FeatureId : AgentDashboard ... Name : DisableFeatureForAll ... IsFeatureEnabled : false ... Everyone

claims.claim: The printed Microsoft 365 admin center path reaches Users > Add for Viva Insights web app access.
claims.quote: Under Microsoft Copilot Dashboard, select Manage access settings for Microsoft Copilot Dashboard. ... At the top, select Users. Search for the people you'd like to add, and select them from the list. ... At the bottom, select Add.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy with VivaInsights, Viva Insights web app, IsFeatureEnabled false and Everyone creates a tenant-wide web-app-disable policy.
claims.quote: Example: Turn off the Viva Insights web app for all users in your tenant ... ModuleId : VivaInsights ... FeatureId : Viva Insights web app ... Name : DisableFeatureForAll ... IsFeatureEnabled : false ... Everyone

claims.claim: Disabling the Viva Insights web app control disables the entire app, not only the Agent Dashboard.
claims.quote: Turning this control off disables the entire app, which includes the Microsoft Copilot Dashboard, Copilot Analytics reports, and advanced analysis and admin tools.

claims.claim: The AI Administrator does not have automatic Viva Insights web app access.
claims.quote: The AI Administrator does not have automatic access to the Viva Insights web app. To gain access, the admin must also add themselves using the process below.
